notes.title: New game announced - Shake the Baby!
notes.notes:
There's been a few years since we released The Handbook. Here's what we have been doing in the meanwhile.

We had a couple of projects that didn't pan off, one of them is still in the backlog and we might revisit it later. We went to a few Game Jams, trying some stuff, prototyping. We also have an idea for a sequel to The Handbook, with a very deep procedural spell system.

About a year ago, we went to Global Game Jam where we started working on what will become our 2nd release. We got really good feedback from the local game dev community, so we have been working on that ever since.

The game is coming out soon, so if you're interested add it to your wishlist! It would help us a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182600/Shake_the_Baby/

We also have a youtube channel now:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CRqxf0-8dvg
